title: Gravity Hates LEGO Builds Like This 😩
description:
This Short is an original LEGO comedy concept built around a LEGO structure that appears to completely ignore the normal rules of gravity. I developed the storyline around the builder questioning whether the unusual construction should even be possible, only for Gravity itself to reluctantly confirm that, unfortunately, it is. I transformed the strange visual effect into a small comedy about someone building something so unnatural that even one of the basic laws of physics seems disappointed by the result. I restructured and transformed the source footage into my own comedic narrative and edited the full Short using After Effects and CapCut, including custom pacing, captions, motion, tracking, visual composition, transitions, and reaction elements. The humor comes from treating gravity like a character forced to admit that this ridiculous-looking LEGO creation somehow still follows the rules
